title: HandLive — call_event/log_new (S→C, no ack)
description: CALL-04 API 2: a new call log entry, sent in ascending entry_id order to every session for which calls are in effect, with the call context it matched. The same schema covers the call_event/log_new envelope encrypted with K_push for the call_missed push when READ_CALL_LOG is granted (CALL-04 API 5).

call_id.description: The call context (CALL-01) matched with the entry; null when none matches.
